cross_gate_synthesis.public_stationxml_lane: JANUS already established that EarthScope public StationXML exposes a static 2004-open response representation across the known 2013 H10S fault epoch, with no encoded fault-era response transition.
cross_gate_synthesis.calibration_sequence_lane: CTBTO public material independently demonstrates that deployed UWS calibration sequences exist in IDC custody and that derived H10S calibration responses changed around the 2013 fault.
cross_gate_synthesis.2013_waveform_lane: The JANUS council-selected public six-channel pre/post waveform gate is archive-blocked on the tested EarthScope route: all 240 frozen 2013 waveform requests returned no data while response metadata remained available.
cross_gate_synthesis.2014_2015_waveform_lane: Later public H10S2 waveforms show a replicated approximately 12-13 dB broadband excess over H10N1 with persistent baseline plus episodic residuals; applying the public StationXML correction barely changes that ratio.
cross_gate_synthesis.physical_lane: Native bathymetry/backscatter remains independent because electronics/calibration can change recorded acoustic contrast but cannot erase real seabed geometry.

new_reverse_nodes.claim: The public StationXML and the CTBTO deployed-calibration history are not equivalent evidence objects: the latter is derived from IDC-stored calibration sequences and contains fault-era information absent from the public StationXML representation.

Because the deployed calibration relay excludes ceramic, preamplifier and riser, a nominal or changed UWS digitizer response is not a complete end-to-end measurement of the physical hydrophone+riser path.

The published 2013 H10S transfer-function differences and the later JANUS 12-13 dB broadband S2/N1 power offset are different statistics over different comparisons. The former therefore cannot be substituted numerically as a complete explanation of the latter; a mixed analogue/riser/noise/site/propagation model remains live.

Published H10 work reports repetitive data-logger electronic noise and spurious coherent zero-lag correlations during roughly 2005-2009. This predates the 2013 H10S1 fault and means PRE-2013 must not automatically be equated with instrument-clean, while the two phenomena must not be merged without a causal bridge.

best_current_whole_picture.lane_A_instrument: A historically documented south-triplet electronics/cross-talk problem exists; its fault-era calibration history is present in CTBTO/IDC provenance but absent from public StationXML, and deployed calibration is not full-chain.
best_current_whole_picture.lane_B_persistent_path_site: A persistent south-vs-north site/trunk/propagation/seabed contribution remains viable because the later 12-13 dB baseline is not reduced by public response correction and the exact 2013 causal comparison is inaccessible through the tested public waveform route.
best_current_whole_picture.lane_C_time_variable_residual: January failures of a fixed scalar and documented variable cross-talk both support retaining an episodic residual process on top of the baseline, without equating those two observations causally.
